description: List and search Data Store Access Entries from OneUptime with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting. Returns an array of Data Store Access Entry objects plus the total matching count.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100.

query.description: Filter criteria for Data Store Access Entries. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

_id.description: Query operators for _id field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

accessKey.description: Query operators for accessKey field of type Long Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

accessLevel.description: Query operators for accessLevel field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

createdAt.description: Query operators for createdAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

dataStoreId.description: Query operators for dataStoreId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

deletedAt.description: Query operators for deletedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

firstSeenAt.description: Query operators for firstSeenAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

grantedVia.description: Query operators for grantedVia field of type Long Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

isExternal.description: Query operators for isExternal field of type Boolean. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull

isPublic.description: Query operators for isPublic field of type Boolean. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull

isSeenInTraces.description: Query operators for isSeenInTraces field of type Boolean. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull

lastSeenAt.description: Query operators for lastSeenAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

lastUsedAt.description: Query operators for lastUsedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

principal.description: Query operators for principal field of type Long Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

principalName.description: Query operators for principalName field of type Long Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

principalType.description: Query operators for principalType field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

projectId.description: Query operators for projectId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

updatedAt.description: Query operators for updatedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

version.description: Query operators for version field of type Number. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

select.description: Optional: field names to return for each Data Store Access Entry (e.g. ["_id", "name"]). Omit to get all readable fields.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Default: 0. Example: skip=10 to start from the 11th record.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Use "ASC" for ascending or "DESC" for descending. Example: {"createdAt": "DESC"} to sort by newest first.

name: list_data_store_access_entries
